text: The Chair and the Members of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place acknowledge, thank and applaud Arlene Campbell, General Manager, Sales & Event Management, for her excellent service and dedication as a valued staff member at Exhibition Place. Arlene has had an accomplished career at Exhibition Place, beginning in 1996; she was one of the first three staff hired to manage Enercare Centre. As Director of Finance, she played a pivotal role in getting the new building staffed and operational for it’s opening in 1997. She became an employee of the Board in January 2009 and was later promoted to Assistant General Manager, then Interim General Manager, Sales & Event Management. Arlene is retiring from her current position of General Manager, Sales & Event Management, after 22 years of dedicated service. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed the Chair, Board of Governors of Exhibition Place, to send a letter to Arlene Campbell, General Manager, Sales and Event Management, Exhibition Place, conveying the Board's appreciation for her 22 years of service at Exhibition Place.
